claims.text: TDV separates Damascus’s capital role, its earlier transfer to Harran and later Abbasid entry. It describes changed government buildings there before Baghdad’s palace and bureaus. al-Mansur’s foundation used a site with earlier settlement. These are distinct governing acts, not one simultaneous Damascus-to-Baghdad handover or evidence of uniform control.

All Damascus offices moved directly to Baghdad in one event.
